comments.author: 端木森
comments.body_html:
Subject: Bug in Roulette.cs — gunClassMultiplier has no effect

Hi, I don’t speak English, so I used an AI to help me find and describe this bug.

The bug: The gunClassMultiplier setting in constants.json has no effect in the game. No matter what values you put in gunClassMultiplier, the weapon class distribution doesn’t change.

The cause: In Roulette.cs line 179, the final gun selection uses the wrong variable:

// Line 165: full weapon list with chanceMultiplier applied var gunArray = AlignChances(RemoveInvalidItems(data.Guns[gunTier]), gunTier);

// Lines 166-174: pick a gun class using gunClassMultiplier weights string selectedGunClass = gunClasses[_random.Next(gunClasses.Count)];

// Lines 175-178: filter by the selected gun class var filteredGunArray = gunArray.Where(gun => gun.gunClass == selectedGunClass).ToList(); if (filteredGunArray.Count == 0) { filteredGunArray = gunArray; }

// Line 179: BUG — uses gunArray instead of filteredGunArray var gun = SelectRandomItem(gunArray); // ❌ should be filteredGunArray filteredGunArray is created but never used. The gun is always selected from gunArray, which has no class filtering applied. So gunClassMultiplier is completely ignored.

The fix: Change line 179 from:

var gun = SelectRandomItem(gunArray); to:

var gun = SelectRandomItem(filteredGunArray);
